projects.title: ShadowBase — Safe SQL Schema Migration & CDC Testing Studio
projects.locationTag: Java 21 • Spring Boot • Debezium CDC • Kafka
projects.metricsSub: PostgreSQL Change Data Capture & Isolated Docker Testcontainers Verification
projects.problemStatement: Running database schema migrations directly on active PostgreSQL tables can cause unexpected query slowdowns or broken application queries if not tested against realistic data first.
projects.architectureSummary: Engineered by Sachin Sahu using Spring Boot, Debezium CDC, Apache Kafka, and Docker Testcontainers to test SQL schema changes against isolated shadow database clones before deployment.
results: Side-by-side SQL migration runner with primary vs. shadow query comparison
Automated row checksum verification before applying production changes
Isolated Docker Testcontainers sandbox for safe schema validation
projects.tags: Java 21 & Spring Boot • Debezium CDC & Kafka • Docker Testcontainers

faqs.question: How much time and budget does it take to build a website or custom software?
faqs.answer: Starter business websites, landing pages, and local digital setups start from ₹10,000 (₹10,000 – ₹18,000) and typically go live within 1 to 2 weeks. Custom web applications, D2C e-commerce stores with 1-Tap UPI, and WhatsApp automation systems scale based on your exact features (₹18,000 – ₹65,000+). Most importantly, every price is flexible and open to direct discussion and negotiation on a quick call or WhatsApp chat—we work within practical founder budgets.

faqs.question: How does the WhatsApp Bot handle customer inquiries and appointment bookings?
faqs.answer: Our WhatsApp bot connects via the Official WhatsApp Business API to reply promptly to common customer inquiries, share your product catalogs or PDF brochures, collect basic lead details (name, requirement, preferred timing), and help schedule appointments—and seamlessly hands over the chat to your human team whenever a personal touch is needed.

faqs.question: How do you improve Google Maps visibility for clinics, showrooms, or retail stores?
faqs.answer: We optimize your Google Business Profile (GBP) categories, service keywords, business photos, and local directory citations so nearby customers can discover you easily. We also provide a digital WhatsApp and direct Google review link that you can send to happy customers so they can quickly leave verified reviews from their phones.

faqs.question: Who owns the source code, domain, and hosting after the project is completed?
faqs.answer: You get 100% source code and account ownership from Day 1. Your GitHub code repository, custom domain, database, WhatsApp Business account, and cloud hosting are set up directly under your business email with zero vendor lock-in.

faqs.question: How does post-launch maintenance, updates, and support work?
faqs.answer: Once your website or software goes live, we provide a 30-day free support window for bug fixes and smooth onboarding, followed by simple, affordable support & optimization whenever you need content updates, new features, or SEO improvements.
